title: MCP Trust Model
description: Client-aligned trust checks for IDE integration (VS Code, etc.)

checks.title: Command is surfaced in metadata
checks.description: Transport config exposes what will actually run (command, args)

checks.title: Environment variables are declared
checks.description: Required env vars are documented (not their values)

checks.title: Source is pinned or verified
checks.description: Server reference includes hash, signature, or locked version

checks.title: Binary/package is signed
checks.description: Distributed artifact has verifiable signature (optional but recommended)

checks.title: SBOM available
checks.description: Software Bill of Materials is provided (optional)

checks.title: First-run guidance documented
checks.description: README guides users through safe initial setup

checks.title: Trust prompts respected
checks.description: Server doesn't try to bypass VS Code trust dialogs

checks.title: Minimal permissions requested
checks.description: Server doesn't request more access than needed for its tools

checks.title: Required permissions documented
checks.description: README lists what permissions/access the server needs

checks.title: Subprocesses are contained
checks.description: Child processes inherit only necessary permissions
